purpose: Guide-informed acquisition priorities applied only within an already selected target build.
priorityMeaning: Higher values are preferred. Every numeric acquisition weight is an inference from author rotation guidance, not a published leveling order, simulation result or measured DPS difference.
constraints: Require matching specialization, supported patch and selected target build ID.
Never change the selected target, choice entry or hero tree to satisfy a priority.
Use live talent definitions and eligibility checks; prerequisites, currency, rank limits and combat restrictions remain authoritative.
Omit unresolved spell identities rather than guessing IDs. Free granted nodes are not spending priorities.
Tiered entries apply only when the live next rank resolves to the listed spell ID; a first-tier rule does not rank unlisted later tiers.
